description: Set up Brain OS in a project folder when no store exists yet (tools return 'No Brain OS store found'). Two steps, never skip the first: (1) call with no confirm — returns the proposed folder, a question for the user, and the exact files that would be created, refreshed, or preserved; nothing is written. It also returns a single-use preview_token. (2) Only after the user explicitly says yes, call again with confirm=true, the same target_dir and options, and that preview_token; writes without a matching token are refused. Existing instruction files are never overwritten; any that need a Brain OS line are listed in plan.needsIntegration — tell the user. Writes nothing outside the project unless include_user_protocol=true. If a store already exists, it reports that and does nothing.

confirm.description: true only after the user approved the folder and plan from the preview call.

include_commands.description: Install Claude Code slash commands into .claude/commands. Default true.

include_user_protocol.description: Also write ~/.claude/brain-os/PROTOCOL.md in the home folder. Default false.

minimal.description: Install only AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md instruction files, skip Copilot/Cursor/Zed/Windsurf pointers.

preview_token.description: Token from the preview call. Required with confirm=true; single-use, expires after 15 minutes.

target_dir.description: Absolute path of the project folder. Required with confirm=true. Must be inside an open workspace folder when the client reports them.

name: brain_setup
